ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Diagrams.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Diagrams.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Diagrams.

2. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

5. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

6. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Generators.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Generators.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

8. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.
   D. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.

9. When learning Earthing and Excess Current Protection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

10. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.

11. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inspection and Testing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.

12. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Digital Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Diagrams and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
